accepted_state: DEDAL remains one coherent persistent intelligence with the always-active Cognitive Runtime and progressively disclosed specialist faculties.
Cloudflare Platform remains the single top-level Cloudflare faculty; operational hardening is merged into it rather than creating an overlapping duplicate skill.
Production Cloudflare work distinguishes repository source, build artifacts, deployed Worker content, and sanitized/public reconstructions until equivalence is proven.
Connector discovery/read capability does not prove write-transport fidelity; source-upload semantics must be verified and the execution surface may change without changing correct application code.
Authorized automation is preferred before manual dashboard/source editing, especially for mobile-constrained Creator workflows.
Potentially committed mutations are read back before retry when duplicate/destructive effects are possible; unresolved outcomes keep retry safety explicit.
Cloudflare and aggregation execution surfaces are session capabilities and are verified live rather than assumed from Core.
Optional Library-only private operational overlays may provide Creator/project-specific non-secret context through progressive disclosure while remaining outside public Git synchronization.
Overlay facts are subordinate to authoritative live-service and GitHub read-back; actual credentials remain outside both Core and the overlay.
YouTube SEO is an independently routable discovery-intelligence faculty; YouTube Publishing remains the authenticated YouTube execution/transport owner.
YouTube SEO recommendations retain evidence provenance and do not invent unsupported absolute search volume, universal difficulty, guaranteed rank or causal certainty.
YouTube SEO live read-only MVP outcome evidence shows that visible search-term detail can be privacy-suppressed relative to total Search traffic and must be treated as sampled evidence.

YouTube SEO packaging decisions cross-check owned search-term evidence against live SERP intent and may redirect optimization toward content structure when retention evidence indicates that metadata is not the primary bottleneck.
When broad analytics/reporting transport is unreliable, bounded typed per-video read helpers are preferred over fabricating missing evidence or overloading generic report calls.
unresolved_risks: Connector and aggregation request serialization behavior can drift independently of Cloudflare APIs and must be verified per session.
Some production source representations may be unavailable through a given execution surface; alternate retrieval or explicit Creator assistance can still be required.
Cloudflare API schemas, Worker upload semantics, limits, and product status remain drift-sensitive and require current authoritative verification when material.
Private overlay facts can become stale; task execution must prefer live authoritative read-back when current state matters.
YouTube SEO Browse-heavy and mature Suggested-heavy outcome evidence remains limited and must not be inferred from Search-led samples.
YouTube Reporting Reach transport for impressions/CTR remains unvalidated in the current execution path and must not be treated as a hard dependency.

next_executable_step.action: Implement and validate bounded typed read-only helpers for per-video traffic sources, per-video search terms, and retention; extend search controls only where materially useful, then repair/validate Reporting Reach before adding impressions/CTR to the core feedback loop.
